{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Take these charges and put them on the turbines. I'll go line the support beams. Set timers for thirty minutes. That ought to be enough for us to get clear and meet Kishpaugh at the rendezvous point.|Ghost to Banks|<ref name="tew">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
'''Timers''' were devices used to trigger [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosives]]. A timer was attached to a [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]], which in turn activated the explosives. A timer was only one method of triggering explosives; other methods included by a wire or [[Comlink/Legends|communicator]] signal.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> Timers were part of the standard demolitions equipment carried by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[radiation zone assault trooper]]s.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
